import numpy as np

# Let us inspect the images to detect colors and bounding boxes of objects

# 2. Table / desk (brown rectangular dining/work table): obs 1, 15, 17, 20
# 3. Cabinet / sideboard (white top, light brown front): obs 1, 15, 17, 20
# 4. Blue vase / cylinder: obs 1, 15, 17, 20
# 5. Grey sofa: obs 1, 14, 15, 18, 19, 20
# 6. Brown chair: obs 14, 18, 19
# 7. Floor lamp: obs 2, 16
# 8. Potted plant: obs 2, 16

im1 = np.array(Image.open('/work/observations/obs_0001.png'))
im15 = np.array(Image.open('/work/observations/obs_0015.png'))
im16 = np.array(Image.open('/work/observations/obs_0016.png'))
im18 = np.array(Image.open('/work/observations/obs_0018.png'))
im19 = np.array(Image.open('/work/observations/obs_0019.png'))
im20 = np.array(Image.open('/work/observations/obs_0020.png'))

print("im1 shape:", im1.shape)

# Let us find the blue vase in im1:
# Blue vase has high blue, low red/green
blue_mask1 = (im1[:,:,2] > 150) & (im1[:,:,0] < 50) & (im1[:,:,1] < 100)
